| Month | Typical High (°C) | Typical Low (°C) | Avg Precipitation | Notes |
|-------|-------------------|------------------|-------------------|-------|
| Jan   | 20–22             | 10–12            | 30 mm             | Cool, dry – great for exploring the Old Quarter. |
| Feb   | 21–23             | 11–13            | 40 mm             | Still cool, but a bit more humid. |
| Mar   | 24–26             | 14–16            | 70 mm             | Spring begins – mild temperatures, occasional showers. |
| Apr   | 27–29             | 17–19            | 120 mm            | Warm, rainy season starts – lots of green foliage. |
| May   | 28–31             | 18–21            | 200 mm            | Hot, humid, frequent afternoon showers. |
| Jun   | 28–32             | 19–22            | 250 mm            | Peak of the rainy season – heavy downpours possible. |
| Jul   | 28–33             | 20–23            | 260 mm            | Very hot, high humidity, heavy rain. |
| Aug   | 27–32             | 19–22            | 240 mm            | Still hot, but slightly less rainfall than July. |
| Sep   | 25–30             | 18–21            | 190 mm            | Transition to cooler months, rain tapers off. |
| Oct   | 22–27             | 15–18            | 110 mm            | Mild, drier – ideal for sightseeing. |
| Nov   | 18–22             | 12–15            | 60 mm             | Cooler, dry – pleasant for outdoor activities. |
| Dec   | 16–20             | 10–13            | 30 mm             | Cool, dry – perfect for exploring the city. |
